act1.assessment: No demonstrated Act1 improvement; the two learner seeds move in opposite directions.

comparison.interpretation: Source campaigns resampled jointly across the same fixed two learner seeds; not independent games or across-training-seed uncertainty. Secondary descriptive evidence.

act1.scope: 32 distinct campaigns, each played by four combat hybrids and the frozen campaign controller alone. Identical noncombat controller; genuine Act1 stopping objective.

correction.reason: The initial conclusion incorrectly called the broader237-demo mixture ordinary-fight imitation. Its native selection explicitly excludes ordinary fights; it combines successful elite/boss openings from the original64 and new128 TRAIN campaign populations.

findings.assessment: Useful behavior can be extracted from the existing policies.8k was fixed before test as a greedy/sampled compromise; duration optimality was not established. Training accuracy approaching100% at16k did not yield the best greedy validation score.
findings.compute_limit: Students inherit250k PPO decisions and add supervised work. Demonstration teachers have1M unique ancestral PPO decisions in total; this is not an equal-total-compute comparison.
findings.evidence: 87 successful TRAIN demonstrations:65 elites and22 bosses,1,797 public decisions. Both original250k parents were fitted at500,2000,8000 and16000 cumulative updates. The same frozen teacher pool was shared.

findings.assessment: Raw continuation regressed. Value warm-up helps but did not fully preserve sampled performance. Critic predictions drift through shared features during actor imitation even with an unchanged value head; this is an observed mechanism, not proof that a separate critic encoder will solve the problem.
findings.evidence: Fresh validation:2k imitation scored73.35% greedy/70.60% sampled. Adding50k PPO decisions scored69.29%/64.65%;400 value-head-only warm-up updates before the same50k budget scored72.92%/67.66%.

findings.assessment: Test improvement versus the matched continuation control remains uncertain. The larger-data endpoint is approximately level with the original250k parent on the test. Independent corpora confound size with population composition.
findings.evidence: Built1024 independent TRAIN campaigns with8362 fights and30830 starts. Matched100k continuations improved greedy fresh validation versus the64-campaign control.

locked_descriptive.interpretation: Conditional on the fixed declared initialization/learner seeds; action repeats and fights within a source campaign are not independent clusters.

findings.assessment: Neither was a clear improvement under the tested budgets. This does not show that additional capacity can never help. The planned near-parameter graph55 control was not started because of the confirmation time reserve.
findings.evidence: 96-wide fresh models were compared at100k decisions with48-wide models; a function-preserving four-layer transfer was compared after100k added decisions. Both used the original development population.

findings.assessment: Some averaging variants improved validation; no combination clearly displaced the simpler imitation pair. Several interventions were inconclusive or regressed. All completed panels and negative results remain in the inventory and MLflow; no blanket claim against these methods is warranted.
findings.evidence: Exact500k continuation, checkpoint averaging, lower entropy, lower learning rate, lambda1, elite/boss-only or openings-only starts, expanded vocabulary, broader/rollout-selected demonstrations, targeted teacher search, imitation mixtures and combinations were screened.

conclusions.main_finding: Successful elite/boss fight imitation is the most promising tested lead. Fresh validation improved, but the frozen greedy test did not establish an overall gain at the95% interval level. Act1 improvement is also inconclusive. No new default policy was selected from test outcomes.

next_priorities.experiment: At matched environment and update budgets, compare plain continuation with value warm-up alone and value warm-up plus a controlled imitation/KL anchor. Keep teacher data, validation, seeds and selection rule fixed. A separate actor/critic encoder is a subsequent ablation, not an established fix.
next_priorities.proposal: Preserve successful behavior while resuming PPO.

next_priorities.experiment: Use the1024-campaign TRAIN population to test more diverse, higher-quality successful hard-fight demonstrations. Compare against the87-demo set at matched supervised updates and retain encounter/source-campaign grouping and public-only inputs. The already-tested237-example mixture also contained only elite/boss fights and did not improve on the87-example set at the matched2k budget; simply adding more wins is not an established solution.
next_priorities.proposal: Expand high-quality elite and boss demonstrations using the existing larger TRAIN corpus.

next_priorities.experiment: Choose the next model and budget on development data, then freeze a new test. The current test is now consumed; do not tune and repeatedly score against it. Report boss counts and Act1 clears separately.
next_priorities.proposal: Use more independent learner seeds and a larger fresh confirmation population.

limits: All performance evidence is from the headless engine, not live game execution.
Balanced combat wins give ordinary fights, elites and bosses equal weight; they are not Act 1 completion rates.
Confidence intervals resample source campaigns jointly across two fixed learner seeds. They do not establish reliability over arbitrary training initializations.
Original and fresh validation were used adaptively. Only the frozen primary locked-test comparison is confirmatory; other comparisons are descriptive.

Successful-fight imitation reuses demonstrations selected from training cases and a shared teacher pool with 1M unique ancestral PPO decisions. It is not an equal-total-compute comparison with one 250k learner.
The 64, 128 and 1,024 campaign training corpora are independently sampled, not nested, so size and population composition are confounded.
Imitation can change shared actor/critic features even when value-head weights remain unchanged. Calibration and subsequent PPO are separate interventions.
Inspector traces retain canonical campaign outcomes. A won isolated combat can display external_stop/cutoff; the combat benchmark owns fight outcomes.

protocol.final_metric: Greedy deployment balanced win rate: arithmetic mean of ordinary, elite and boss fight-win rates, averaged across fixed learner seeds. Report each kind and each seed separately.
protocol.final_population: Every opening fight in the new corpus test split. No excluded losses, retries or test-trained features. Native benchmark also includes heuristic and random legal baselines.
protocol.final_selection: Before opening the native held-out test, freeze up to eight checkpoint identities and one primary candidate-versus-control comparison. Prefer a control matched on ancestral checkpoint and additional training budget. Other comparisons are secondary descriptive evidence.
protocol.replication: Compare shortlisted candidate checkpoint identities with matched controls on all fresh validation openings. Freeze each plan before any of its games. Fresh validation is development data after examination.
protocol.screening: Original validation is adaptive development. Shortlist promising arms using balanced sampled wins averaged across two learner seeds, individual seed directions, and greedy deployment behavior. More than one candidate may remain inconclusive.
protocol.stopping: Reserve the end of the seven-hour session for held-out evaluation, artifact verification and reporting. Do not select, tune or retrain from held-out test outcomes.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired source-campaign bootstrap conditional on the two fixed learner seeds. One primary95% interval; other intervals are descriptive and not adjusted for adaptive multiple comparisons. No claim of general reliability across learner seeds.

secondary_act1_confirmation.scope: Locked secondary Act1 integration confirmation with a fixed noncombat controller. These are complete Act1clears, unlike the combat-start win metric. No selection, further fitting or checkpoint promotion is based on these test results.

source_archive.scope: Exact public production-source snapshot, analysis assets, package declarations, and top-level research recipes from the two precursor studies and this session. It does not include private corpora, optimizer/RNG resumes, public traces, trained inference bundles or all referenced plans/results. It is an auditable source snapshot, not a self-contained executable experiment download. Reproduction also requires the hash-bound local artifacts documented by the research evidence and equivalent dependency/runtime settings.
